issues.t: Engine connecting rod bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Knocking from the engine, an oil leak, or a sudden loss of power while driving. Many cars show no sign before it fails.
issues.why: On a small number of 2025 K4s, the bolts that hold the connecting rods to the crankshaft may not have been tightened properly at the factory, so a rod can come loose and wreck the engine.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls right away. If the engine starts knocking or loses power, pull over safely and have it towed rather than driven. Dealers replace the engine assembly for free.

issues.t: Instrument panel display can go blank (recall)
issues.sym: The digital gauge cluster (and sometimes the center screen) turns off or blinks off and on while driving, so you lose the speedometer, tire pressure and warning lights.
issues.why: A software error in the instrument panel display. Kia recalled 2025 K4s and other models for it.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Kia fixes it with a free software update, over the air or at a dealer. Until then, if the screen goes dark, drive gently and keep a safe distance.

issues.sym: A sharp pop or snap like a stone hitting the glass, often in hot sun or with the A/C on, followed by chips or cracks that spread. Some owners report repeat cracks after replacement.
issues.why: Several owners have reported this to NHTSA. The cause is not confirmed; owners suspect stress in the glass or how it is mounted.
issues.next: Have any crack checked, since a cracked windshield can weaken roof support and blur the driver-assist camera. Ask the dealer to document the noise and open a case with Kia before paying for glass.

issues.t: Lane keeping steers the car toward another lane
issues.sym: The steering tugs or pulls the car out of its lane on the highway, sometimes even when owners say lane assist is off.
issues.why: Several owners have reported the lane departure and lane-following features making unwanted steering moves. Kia has not issued a recall for this.
issues.next: Keep both hands on the wheel. Check the settings menu for lane keeping, and have a dealer check camera aim and wheel alignment. Report it to NHTSA if it continues.

issues.t: Driver-assist shuts off or gives false warnings
issues.sym: A "camera obscured" message in rain, inattentive-driver warnings with hands on the wheel, or emergency braking for things that are not there.
issues.why: Owners report the front camera and radar-based safety features switching off in bad weather or reacting to false targets.
issues.next: Clean the windshield in front of the camera and the front sensor. If warnings or hard braking happen in clear weather, have a dealer check and recalibrate the sensors.

issues.sym: A check engine light, jerking, loss of acceleration, or the car getting stuck in Park. One dealer found transmission pressure too high and replaced the transmission.
issues.why: A few owners of 2.0L cars with the CVT-style IVT have reported transmission failures early in the car's life.
issues.next: If the car jerks, won't accelerate or shows a transmission warning, get it to a Kia dealer soon. Keep every repair order in case of repeat failures.

issues.sym: The car is slow to pick up speed, especially on the highway, or hesitates and jerks after warming up.
issues.why: Owners have reported hesitation to NHTSA, but no single cause has been found. Transmission behavior is often suspected.
issues.next: Note when it happens and whether a warning light shows, then have a dealer road-test it and check for software updates.

issues.sym: Popping, clicking or snapping sounds from the dashboard while driving.
issues.why: Owners report dash noises; one was paired with a gauge cluster failure. The cause has not been pinned down.
issues.next: Note when it happens (heat, bumps, A/C use) and have the dealer listen for it. If gauges also act up, check for the instrument panel recall.

issues.t: Parking brake won't release with ESC and driver-assist warnings
issues.sym: Driver-assist and stability control (ESC) warnings come on, and the electronic parking brake won't release until the system resets.
issues.why: An owner reported this repeatedly; the dealer could not find stored codes. The cause is not known.
issues.next: Don't force the car to move with the parking brake on. Record the warnings with your phone and have a dealer scan the brake and ESC systems.

issues.t: Tire pressure warning comes on with correct pressures
issues.sym: The tire pressure light flashes or comes on during highway driving even though the tires are properly filled.
issues.why: An owner reported repeated false tire pressure warnings that dealer reprogramming did not fix.
issues.next: Check all four tires with a gauge first. If they are correct, have the tire pressure sensors and system checked.

issues.t: Kia Connect or window lock switch not working until reset
issues.sym: The Kia Connect app won't link to the car, or the rear windows still work with the window lock switch on.
issues.why: Owners report these from new. Dealers fixed them with a system reset.
issues.next: Ask the dealer for a system reset and software update. Check the window lock before carrying young children.

issues.t: Sunroof won't open or close properly
issues.sym: The sunroof stops partway or won't open or close fully.
issues.why: An owner reported this, and Kia offered a possible software adjustment.
issues.next: Close it fully before parking outdoors if you can. Ask a dealer to re-initialize the sunroof and check for updates.
